name: traceroost-desktop
description: TraceRoost desktop shell — Electron app and menu bar/tray icon around the standalone collector and dashboard (macOS, Linux, Windows)

scripts.build: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run bundle && pnpm run stage && pnpm run notices
scripts.build:release: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run bundle:release && pnpm run stage && pnpm run notices
scripts.pack: pnpm run build:release && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 && pnpm run checksums
scripts.pack:host: pnpm run build:release && electron-builder --mac && pnpm run checksums
scripts.pack:linux: pnpm run build:release && electron-builder --linux --x64 --arm64 && pnpm run checksums
scripts.pack:linux:host: pnpm run build:release && electron-builder --linux && pnpm run checksums
scripts.pack:win: pnpm run build:release && electron-builder --win --x64 && electron-builder --win --arm64 && pnpm run checksums
scripts.pack:win:host: pnpm run build:release && electron-builder --win && pnpm run checksums

author: TraceRoost
